title: Growth Content Engineer
description:
This is a remote position available anywhere in the world! Linkedin makes us show a country, but we hire the best people wherever they are.

At Railway, we make it extremely simple for engineers to deploy logic without thinking about servers. Our goal is to make developers orders of magnitude more efficient by becoming the operating system for modern development.

Content marketing is an often misunderstood role, and we have shaped this particular role to be focused on AEO via a combination of writing and engineering. You should be knowledgeable about modern cloud infra, how to rank in both search and agents, and be an excellent writer.

This is a high impact, high agency role where you are given a high degree of autonomy to work with any function you desire while receiving any support from the team you need. As an early hire in this area, we expect you to wear a lot of hats while setting the strategy.

Want to learn about our work culture? Here is a three-part blog series that will help you see the unique ways our team works (Parts 1 https://blog.railway.app/p/how-we-work, 2 https://blog.railway.app/p/how-we-work-volume-ii, 3 https://blog.railway.app/p/how-we-work-volume-iii, and 4 https://blog.railway.com/p/how-we-work-volume-iv).

About the role

For this role, you will:

- Research and report on our current performance in search, agents, and LLM chat to inform where our content needs to be improved or added to.

- Engineer content across our owned assets to drive both conventional search (SEO) as well as agentic search (AEO).

- Build standalone app examples to clarify for both new users and LLMs what can be done on Railway and how Railway works.

- Make our documentation and blog into top-ranked assets, including writing guides and refining our site architecture.

- Own our technical site performance end-to-end, improving our searchability.

About you

- Strong and clear communication style, particularly in writing

- Ability to analyze data in AEO tools (like Gauge) and user trends to impact what you write about, and measure the results of your work.

- A enthusiast about our product, Railway uses Railway to build Railway. (Say that 5 times fast) You should be able to share insights with developers of all stripes to let them know how our product can help them

- A great sense of direction and prioritization when it comes to dealing with the ambiguity of an early stage startup

- Someone who is comfortable in a few different languages/stacks and can create educational content on how to deploy those projects on a public cloud (the status quo) or Railway (the thing we hope to be better than the status quo)

- Able to take really technical concepts and make it as easy to understand as possible

We value and love to work with diverse persons from all backgrounds

Things to Know

For better or worse, we're a startup; our team dynamics are different from companies of different sizes and stages.

- We're distributed ALL across the globe, and that's only going to be more and more distributed. As a result, stuff is ALWAYS happening.

- We do NOT expect you to work all the time, but you'll have to be diligent about your boundaries because the end of your day may overlap with the start of someone else's.

- We're a small team, with high ownership, who are not only passionate about what we do, but seek to be exceptional as well. At the time of writing we're 21, serving hundreds of thousands of users. There's a lot of stuff going on, and a lot of ambiguity.

- We want you to own it. We believe that ownership is a key to growth, and part of that growth is not only being able to make the choices, but owning the success, or failure, that comes with those choices.

Benefits and Perks

At Railway, we provide best in class benefits. Great salary, full health benefits including dependents, strong equity grants, equipment stipend, and much more. For more details, check back on the main careers page https://railway.app/careers/developer-relati

Field Access Lead (FAL)

The Field Access Lead (FAL) works to execute Pfizer ’s strategic vision for patient access for approved therapies while maintaining appropriate compliance standards.

The position is field based, reports directly to the Field Access Director and works in close collaboration with commercial and US Market Access colleagues. Through the demonstration of integrity and business excellence, the FAL engages in person both proactively and reactively with territory aligned accounts to help ensure patient access and the resolution of potential customer challenges.

Acting as the main point of contact for patient access, the FAL position primarily focuses on accounts with workflow complexities including multi-provider specialty groups, IDNs, Hospital systems and integrated pharmacy delivery networks. This role provides payer policy education at the local, regional, and national level to help avert and resolve patient access issues in a timely manner. The FAL is responsible for developing, and maintaining, key business enabling relationships to ensure optimal customer experience within their respective territories.

Candidates must have a strong knowledge of Commercial & Medicare insurance benefit structures and experience communicating payer policy & utilization management criteria to key internal and external stakeholders. This role serves as the local expert on patient access and requires a keen, proven, sense of business acumen within a high-paced environment.

title: Enterprise Sales Executive
description:
Enterprise Sales Executive - Digital Asset Platform (APEX & Treasury)
About AlphaPoint

AlphaPoint is the infrastructure platform behind digital asset businesses worldwide. Since 2013, we have powered exchanges, brokerages, banks, and fintechs across dozens of countries, giving them the trading, custody connectivity, tokenization, treasury, and settlement capabilities they need to operate in digital assets at institutional scale.
We are not a collection of products in a box. AlphaPoint is a single platform with many capabilities: one integration that lets a client offer trading, brokerage, treasury, and stablecoin workflows to their end users, connect to the liquidity venues, custodians, and banking partners of their choice, and expand into new use cases without re-platforming. Every super app needs a super platform underneath it. That is what we build.
About the Role
We are hiring a Sales Executive to open new markets for the AlphaPoint platform, with APEX (our trading and brokerage infrastructure) and APEX Treasury (our treasury and settlement layer) as the lead offerings. This is a new-business role. You will build your own pipeline, run complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation to signature, and land accounts that grow with us as they add capabilities.
Our buyers fall into two groups. The first are firms launching a new exchange or brokerage and looking for the platform to build it on. The second, and larger, are firms that already have an established base of end users or assets and want to give those users access to digital assets: investment platforms and online brokers, asset managers and trading firms, private wealth and RIA platforms, fintechs adding crypto to an existing product, and the retirement channel, where brokers and IRA providers are bringing bitcoin ETFs and spot crypto to retirement accounts.
This is a builder role for someone with deep domain knowledge. You know how a broker-dealer, an asset manager, or a wealth platform actually works, what they need from a technology partner to launch digital assets, and who inside the building signs off on it. You can hold a first meeting with a CEO and a working session with a head of trading or a CTO in the same day, and you can teach a market what it should be asking for.
What You Will Do

• Own new-business revenue for the AlphaPoint platform in your territory, selling APEX and APEX Treasury as an integrated platform rather than as standalone products, and consistently meet or exceed quota.

• Build pipeline from scratch through your own network, targeted outbound, referral and partner channels, industry events, and content, with disciplined territory and account planning behind it.

• Lead complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, product, technology, compliance, and legal, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and contract close.

• Develop and execute go-to-market plays for each target segment: investment platforms and brokers, asset managers and trading firms, private wealth, fintechs entering crypto, and retirement and IRA providers.

• Act as a trusted advisor to prospects on how to structure a digital asset offering: which capabilities to launch first, how to integrate with existing systems and custodians, and how to stay within the regulatory perimeter in each market.

• Partner with Solutions Engineers, Product, and Engineering to scope integrations and pilots, and bring structured market and client feedback back into the roadmap.

• Work with Marketing on segment-specific campaigns, case studies, and events, and represent AlphaPoint at industry conferences and forums to build visibility and credibility in your markets.

• Maintain an accurate, well-qualified pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, with clear next steps and close plans on every opportunity, and report weekly on pipeline health and progress to target.

• Resourceful and hands-on: finds a way to move a deal forward regardless

description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior or Staff Backend Engineer with the Database Excellence group , you'll build and evolve database automation and PostgreSQL as a service capabilities for GitLab. The level will be determined during the hiring process. You'll use Go to automate the full lifecycle of PostgreSQL across GitLab's infrastructure, making database operations safer, more consistent, and easier to scale for databases that sit behind high-throughput, always-on internet services. You'll work closely with partner teams to shape how GitLab provisions and manages PostgreSQL in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment.

Some examples of our projects:

• SQL Traffic Replay Tooling , which validates upgrades and changes against real production workloads.

• PostgreSQL as a Service Platform , which provides standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management for internal product databases.

• PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrade Automation , which supports safe, repeatable major upgrades at GitLab.com scale.

What you’ll do

• Design, build, and maintain Go-based automation that manages the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning, reducing reactive operational work that currently takes more than 80% of the team's time.

• Build automation that works across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure, and evaluate operator-based approaches as the platform evolves.

• Use AI agents as a regular part of building and operating services, including implementation, review, and reducing repetitive work, while keeping the context agents need in the repository so the whole team can build on it.

• Build for internet scale by designing automation and services for high-throughput, always-on production workloads, where GitLab.com traffic sets the bar for correctness, latency, and availability.

• Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into one coherent PostgreSQL platform instead of creating bespoke setups for each database.

• Build GitLab's PostgreSQL as a service platform to replace bespoke database setups with standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management, so supporting more databases doesn't require growing the operations team at the same rate.

• Collaborate closely with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, and other engineering teams to design and ship high-performing solutions.

• Research, design, and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, and data health

We have developed an autonomy stack that receives user intent, responds to detections processed at the edge, and coordinates flight patterns for groups of assets. As a Supply Chain Planner, you will join our Operational Procurement team to help manage the cycle of purchasing the packaging ingredients that compose our HelloFresh boxes. This is a hands-on role where you independently oversee the end-to-end ordering process, from delivery scheduling and shortage management to driving improvements in supplier performance.

You will act as a primary point of contact for our partners, ensuring that every shipment meets our standards for quality and timing. Your day-to-day focus centers on hitting clear performance targets, specifically maintaining high OTIFIQ (On Time, In Full, In Quality) levels while actively working to reduce error rates and waste. We are looking for a practical problem-solver who enjoys taking ownership of a fast-moving process and contributing to a more efficient, sustainable supply chain.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Operational buyer : Manage the end-to-end purchase order process for your assigned supplier portfolio, ensuring timely and accurate deliveries.

• Coordinate: Coordinate  daily with suppliers, production, and internal stakeholders to resolve shortages, quality issues, and delivery deviations

• Operational Point of Contact: Serve as the primary link between suppliers and our production, product and FSQA teams to coordinate all planning activities and operational matters. Ensuring enablement and performance tracking of new ingredients (planning frequency, errors & waste) as well as product substitution management

• Relationship Development:  Build and maintain collaborative, long-term partnerships with our supplier base through the onboarding process, supplier performance reviews, supplier visits and regular contact.

• Process Optimization: Identify and implement practical improvements to refine our supply chain workflows and increase efficiency. Support with projects from other teams or within your category.

• Reporting : You own your KPI’s and ensure that targets are met, perform rootcause analysis and preventive actions and present this in WBR’s. You flag structural challenge, follow-up with suppliers/internal teams to prevent situations from happening again

• Order Accuracy:  Monitor forecast & order flows closely to maintain high service levels and minimize discrepancies in the supply chain.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• Educational Background: Degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: 2+ years of relevant experience, ideally within a fast-paced supply chain environment.

• Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel; you are comfortable using data to track performance and inform your decisions.

• Agility: A quick learner who adapts easily to new processes and remains solution-oriented when priorities shift.

• Operational Rigor: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a disciplined approach to managing complex ordering schedules.

• Proactivity: The ability to anticipate potential issues and react effectively to unexpected supply chain challenges.

• Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

Pridruži nam se kao Agent tehničke podrške u oblasti rešenja za sluh (nemački jezik)!

Kako bi izgledao tvoj rad na ovoj poziciji:

• Kada je klijentu potreban savet i kontaktira nas putem digitalnih kanala - ti bi bio/la prva osoba sa kojom bi stupili u kontakt

• Potrebno je koordinisati zakazivanja termina konsultacija sa klijentima u vezi pomoćnih aparata za sluh (telefonom i email-om) - ti ćeš biti spona izmedju njihovog problema i rešenja koja nudimo

• Bićeš podrška u pravom smislu - tu smo da podržimo klijente na njihovom putu ka dobrom sluhu i da im odgovorimo na sva pitanja

Kako da znaš da si ti prava osoba za ovu poziciju:

• Odlično govoriš i pišeš nemački jezik - ovo je važno kako bismo dobro razumeli klijenta i adekvatno odgovorili na njihovo pitanje ili brigu

• Imaš relevantno iskustvo - poznat ti je rad sa klijentima, komunikacija sa njima i odgovaranje na njihove upite i brige

• Komunikativan/a si i empatičan/na - ovo su važne osobine za uspešnu komunikaciju sa klijentom

• Odgovornost i orijentisanost na rešenje su osobine koje te odlikuju - važno je da imamo ažurnu i uspešnu komunikaciju sa klijentima

• Rad na računaru ti nije stran - sva komunikacija sa korisnicima se odigrava putem računara

Kako izgleda život u Transcom u?

U Transcom u smo neumorno posvećeni. Našim klijentima i jedni drugima. Svakog dana neko započne svoje putovanje sa Transcom om. Uzimajući potencijal koji imaju danas i pretvarajući ga u veštine za budućnost. Dobijanje priznanja za naporan rad, timskog igrača i podršku drugima. Zagovaranje pozitivnih, trajnih promena u svojim timovima i zajednicama. Takvi smo mi u Transcom u. Ovde nam je stalo, i navijamo jedni za druge. Uključeni ste, baš takvi kakvi jeste, od prvog dana. A sa pravim načinom razmišljanja, nema granice koliko daleko možemo ići zajedno.

title: Technical Implementation Specialist
description:
About MD Integrations

At MD Integrations , we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care-all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful.

MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is the central point of contact and technical liaison for MDI customers in active implementation and supporting existing customers as they expand their integration offerings. You’ll lead the technical implementation process from kickoff to go-live, mapping and configuring API connections, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting issues to keep integrations on track.

This role is ideal for someone technically literate and highly comfortable working with APIs who enjoys problem-solving, learning new systems, and explaining complex concepts clearly to non-technical customers. This is not a software engineering role: you won’t be writing production code, but you will need to be confident configuring, testing, and debugging API connections independently. You’ll partner closely with the partner success and engineering teams, escalating clearly documented issues when they’re beyond the scope of this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical point of contact for new customers throughout implementation, and for existing customers expanding their integration footprint, guiding each engagement from kickoff through go-live.

• Lead the end-to-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.

• Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.

• Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.

• Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back-and-forth.

• Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.

• Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.

• Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.

• Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

Success Looks Like…

• Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go-live.

• High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.

• Low number of escalations needing hands-on engineering resources.

• Accuracy and completeness of documentation.

• Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.

• Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.

• Familiarity with data map

title: Stage - Assistant chef de projet pour déploiement (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
description:
Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Doctolib Prévention , une équipe d'entrepreneur(euse)s qui construit une nouvelle activité depuis 2022 avec l'ambition de transformer le système de santé vers plus de prévention. 

Il existe trois formes de prévention : primaire (de l’exercice physique à la nutrition, la lutte contre les addictions ou encore la vaccination), secondaire (limiter l’impact de la maladie sur la santé à travers le dépistage du cancer du sein, de l’utérus…), et tertiaire (l’ensemble des moyens mis en œuvre pour éviter la survenue de complications et de rechutes pour les personnes atteintes de maladies chroniques). La France est bonne élève sur la prévention tertiaire, très curative, mais en retard sur la prévention primaire et secondaire, par rapport à d’autres pays européens.

• Pour les patients : notre objectif est de leur donner les moyens de devenir acteurs de leur santé avec une approche préventive, en commençant par leur offrir une information de qualité et la capacité d’agir simplement lors des campagnes de prévention nationales

• Pour les professionnels de santé : notre objectif est de leur fournir les outils adéquats pour réussir le virage vers une médecine plus préventive, en commençant par fournir une information de qualité sur l’accompagnement des patients lors des campagnes de prévention nationales

• Nous avons relayé plus d’une centaine de campagnes depuis notre lancement, en prévention primaire et secondaire (facteurs de risque, vaccination, dépistages, santé mentale…) avec des acteurs institutionnels (Santé Publique France, CNAM, Ministères…), associatifs et privés (eg : L’Oréal, MSD etc). Les campagnes sont relayées auprès de millions de Français avec un bel impact en termes de passage à l’action.

 

Vos missions

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

• Contrats : Rédaction des contrats en utilisant les modèles fournis par l'équipe Legal, Suivi des contrats, y compris la mise à disposition des contrats et la gestion des signatures

• Facturation : Suivi de la facturation, y compris la création de factures ainsi que le suivi des règlements

• Marketing : Coordination avec les équipes marketing, medical excellence et site web pour la création des contenus

• Data et suivi de performance : Suivi quotidien de la performance des campagnes en cours et amélioration continue en lien avec le marketing, préparation des présentations clients, notamment les réunions de brief et le partage des résultats de campagnes et analyses ad hoc : benchmark de performance par cible, analyse des AB test pour optimiser la performance de nos campagnes

 

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

• Vous êtes en Master 1 ou Master 2, idéalement dans une école de commerce, 

• Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux(euse) et organisé(e),

• Vous aimez travailler en autonomie et apprendre,

• Vous êtes à l’aise avec Excel et les chiffres,

• Vous savez réagir de manière structurée dans des situations concrètes

 

Notre offre

• Un programme d’onboarding complet avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation en recrutement

• Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care

• Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,50 € par jour, dont 4,50 € pris en charge par Doctolib

• Une subvention du comité d'entreprise pour le remboursement partiel d'adhésions à des activités sportives ou de loisirs

• Un remboursement à 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun

• Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride et au bureau

title: Műszakvezető Logisztika Biatorbágy
description:
Helyszín: Biatorbágy, Mészárosok útja 6.

A kifli.hu http://kifli.hu-nál a logisztika és az ellátási lánc nem a háttérben meghúzódó folyamat, hanem a vásárlói élményünk szive

A raktári operációnk gyors, adatalapú és folyamatosan fejlődik. Ebben a környezetben az Area Manager nem egy irodában ülő megfigyelő: te vagy a logisztikai központ egy meghatározott területének igazi gazdája, aki kézben tartja a napi teljesítményt, és motiválja a csapatot a legjobb eredmények elérésére.

Olyan vezetőt keresünk, aki szeret jelen lenni a folyamatok sűrűjében, jól igazodik el a mutatók (KPI-ok) világában, és készen áll arra, hogy a csoportvezetőkből és raktári munkatársakból a legjobbat hozza ki. Ez a pozíció kiváló ugródeszka a további vezetői fejlődéshez a gyorsan növekvő e-kereskedelmi szektorban.

Miért izgalmas ez a pozíció?

- Valódi felelősség és hatás: Egy teljes operatív terület működéséért, biztonságáért és teljesítményéért felelsz, döntéseid azonnal meglátszanak az eredményekben.

- Közvetlen csapatépítés: Nemcsak irányítod, hanem fejleszted is a munkatársakat, alakítva a felelősségteljes és elkötelezett kultúrát.

- Folyamatos fejlődési lehetőség: Egy dinamikusan skálázódó, modern logisztikai környezetben léphetsz előre a vezetői karrierlétrán.

- Keresztfunkcionális együttműködés: Szorosan együttdolgozol a munkavédelmi, automatizációs, HR, IT és folyamatfejlesztési csapattal.

- Problémamegoldás élesben: Nem sablonos feladataid lesznek; a napi operatív kihívásokat feltárod, és fenntartható megoldásokat vezetsz be.

Mi lesz a feladatod

- Irányítod és biztosítod az adott terület napi operatív működését, elerve a biztonsági, minőségi és termelékenységi mutatókat (KPI-ok).

- Vezeted, motiválod és fejleszted a területen dolgozó munkatársakat.

- Támogatod a biztonsági kultúrát: példamutatással, proaktív beavatkozásokkal és rendszeres auditokkal garantálod a munkavédelmi szabályok betartását.

- Elemzed az operatív problémák kiváltó okait, és hosszú távú, hatékony megoldásokat léptetsz életbe.

- Aktívan hozzájárulsz a munkaerő-tervezéshez, a folyamatok optimalizálásához és a hatékonyságnövelő kezdeményezésekhez.

- Szorosan együttműködsz a társfőosztályokkal (automatizáció, karbantartás, operációs kiválóság, pénzügy) a működési akadályok elhárításában.

- Biztosítod a munkaügyi jogszabályok, a belső működési eljárások és a vállalati előírások teljes körű betartását.

Kit keresünk

- Tapasztalat: 1-3 év embereket vezetői, logisztikai, gyártási vagy operációs területen szerzett tapasztalat.

- Vezetői attitűd: Erős határozottság, kiváló kommunikációs készség és képesség a csapatok motiválására dinamikus, gyors tempójú környezetben.

- Adat- és KPI-szemlélet: Otthonosan mozgsz az adatelemzésben, és tudod, hogyan kell a teljesítménymutatókat a gyakorlati működés szolgálatába állítani.

- Nyelvtudás: Kommunikációképes angol nyelvtudás.

- Rugalmasság: A logisztika pörög - nyitottság a több műszakos munkarendre, beleértve a hétvégi és ünnepnapi műszakokat is. (Délelőtt: 04:00-14:15
Délután: 13:30-23:15)

- Iskolai végzettség: Legalább középfokú végzettség (felsőfokú tanulmányok vagy diplomás háttér előny).

Előnyt jelent:

- Felsőfokú végzettség, MBA vagy logisztikai/üzleti képzettség.

- E-kereskedelmi, raktárirányítási (WMS) vagy ellátási lánc környezetben szerzett tapasztalat.

Amit kínálunk:

- Versenyképes jövedelem

- Cafeteria és Kifli Prémium tagság és 10% visszatérítés kreditekben

- Fiatalos, barátságos és vidám csapat

- Folyamatos fejlődési lehetőség scale-up környezetben

title: Gestionnaire de programme technique principal·e - FinOps
description:
Bonjour! Merci de votre visite 👋

L'équipe Operations Produit et Technologie recherche une personne au poste de Gestionnaire de programme technique principal·e pour se joindre à elle et prendre en charge la gestion, l'optimisation et la mise à l'échelle des dépenses liées au nuage, aux fournisseurs et à l'IA à l'échelle de l'organisation.

Vous définirez la stratégie FinOps elle-même - non seulement en gérant un programme de coûts existant, mais en décidant des éléments à optimiser, de l'ordre de priorité et des raisons sous-jacentes. La gestion des coûts liés au nuage et aux fournisseurs s'appuie sur des pratiques établies que nous souhaitons adapter et automatiser; ce n'est pas le cas pour les dépenses en IA. Vous définirez et bâtirez le FinOps pour l'IA, tout en faisant évoluer les pratiques existantes vers un système plus automatisé.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de spécialiste technique de très haut niveau. Vous apporterez une expertise technique suffisante pour concevoir ou façonner directement les automatisations, les tableaux de bord et les recommandations d'optimisation, ainsi qu'un jugement stratégique permettant d'influencer la réflexion de la direction sur les compromis financiers et le partenariat avec les équipes des finances, de l'approvisionnement et d'autres fonctions concernant la gestion et l'optimisation des fournisseurs.

Ce que vous ferez

Définir la stratégie FinOps

- Détenir la responsabilité de la stratégie de gestion des coûts liés au nuage, aux fournisseurs et à l'IA dans l'ensemble de l'organisation - et pas seulement de l'exécution d'une feuille de route existante.

- Réévaluer continuellement les éléments à optimiser, l'ordre des priorités et les raisons motivant ces choix, en fonction de la concentration réelle des dépenses et des risques.

- Bâtir le cadre de gestion des coûts de l'IA, un domaine qui ne dispose pas encore de modèle établi dans l'industrie.

Favoriser l'optimisation des coûts grâce à une expertise technique approfondie

- Analyser l'utilisation du nuage, les contrats des fournisseurs et les dépenses en IA pour cibler les inefficacités et élaborer des stratégies visant à réduire les coûts inutiles.

- Concevoir ou façonner directement les tableaux de bord, les automatisations et les systèmes de surveillance qui rendent les coûts visibles et exploitables, avec une profondeur technique équivalente à celle d'une personne occupant un poste d'ingénierie senior.

- Proposer des optimisations techniques spécifiques, et pas seulement des recommandations de processus, et savoir quand une suggestion nécessite un partenariat d'ingénierie plus poussé.

- Appliquer une expérience pratique dans la création et l'automatisation avec l'IA, au lieu de simplement orienter les autres équipes.

Diriger le programme à l'échelle de l'organisation

- Superviser et, dans certains cas, exécuter simultanément plusieurs initiatives d'optimisation des coûts.

- Prendre en charge la structure de suivi - attribution des coûts, surveillance et alertes - et l'utiliser pour présenter à la direction un bilan clair et fiable des dépenses et des économies.

- Travailler en partenariat avec l'équipe de planification et d'analyse financières (FP&A) pour définir et établir des métriques de coûts clés, offrant à la direction une perspective financière plus précise sur l'efficacité des coûts.

- Gérer les dépendances interfonctionnelles, les risques et le changement au sein des équipes de SRE, d'ingénierie, de données, de FP&A et d'approvisionnement.

Exercer une influence au niveau de la direction

- Présenter des perspectives sur la faisabilité, les échéanciers, les risques et les compromis de coûts directement à la haute direction, afin d'orienter les décisions qui touchent le budget réel et les choix d'infrastructure.

- Équilibrer les normes centralisées de gestion des coûts avec l'autonomie dont les unités d'affaires individuelles ont besoin pour fonctionner efficacement.

- Faire émerger de manière proactive les problèmes

title: Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks
description:
350.org is looking for a Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks who will be responsible for visible and meaningful engagement of a global network of activists, supporters and partners in our national and global campaigns.
About 350.org

350’s mission is to keep carbon in our atmosphere at a safe level, below 350 parts per million. We do this by mobilizing ordinary people to campaign for universal access to clean energy and an end to fossil fuels. Our campaigns are rooted in local organizing, so that while achieving measurable reductions in fossil fuel emissions, we also build the power and potential of the climate movement for yet more impact to come. The values that guide and drive our work are listed here.
350.org is an equal opportunity employer. 350.org strives to be an inclusive and collaborative group of people who bring a variety of approaches to the work we do. We’re committed to the principles of justice, and we try to build a safe workplace where everyone is treated fairly and enjoys working together. We value new perspectives, ideas of all sorts, and different ways of working. Diverse perspectives and experiences improve the way 350.org carries out our work - including what we decide to work on and how creatively/effectively we do that. We do our best to make staff positions accessible to all potential team members, regardless of race, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, assigned gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or identity, religion or creed, veteran status, marital or parental status, and genetic information. We also strive to include team members in communities most impacted by climate change or impacted by other kinds of environmental, social, and economic injustice.
About the Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks
The Global Lead, Partnerships and Networks is responsible for visible and meaningful engagement of a global network of activists, supporters and partners into our national and global campaigns. This role manages a small distributed team responsible for building powerful, politically effective networks of local groups, volunteers and partners across regions. The role is accountable for setting direction, driving delivery, and ensuring that partnerships and network-building work contributes directly to campaign outcomes, organisational priorities and movement power. This role works closely with Country teams to develop, strengthen and expand partnerships outside the climate justice ecosystem.
Duties and Responsibilities:

• Lead the development of network strategy for partners, allies and local groups that is tailored to context and linked to campaign priorities.

• Ensure systems are in place to track, evaluate, and report on network health, volunteer engagement, and leadership development.

• Bring global and regional insight into global mobilisation planning, ensuring networks are a core delivery mechanism.

• Build and maintain strategic relationships across the climate movement ecosystem and institutions, from frontline and Indigenous partners to senior external stakeholders, with sound political judgement and integrity.

• Line manages a team of two Regional Network Coordinators, setting a high bar for performance, judgement and collaboration; making sound strategic choices about partnerships, leadership development and engagement in key campaigns.

• Lead on our work and relationships with existing and new 350 affiliates applying strategic thinking and collaboration with high level relationship management.

• Build strong cross-regional collaboration and ensure lessons, tactics and political insight are shared across regions and with relevant teams.

• Ensure regional network work is fully aligned with 350.org ’s global strategy, campaign priorities and organisational standards.

• Develop and strengthen mechanisms for sharing learnings, best practices, and innovations across networks and with global teams.

• Ensure effective communication channels are in place

About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for

• Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

• Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

• Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application

title: Research Program Manager, Frontier Assurance

About the Team

The Frontier Assurance team brings independent scrutiny into OpenAI’s safety decisions and helps the public understand and assess our safety work. We lead third-party assessments and safeguard testing for OpenAI’s flagship launches, pilot new assurance mechanisms such as embedded auditing, run our misalignment disclosure process, and incorporate independent expert input as evidence for critical safety decisions.

About the Role

As a Research Program Manager on the Frontier Assurance team, you will build programs that bring independent expertise into frontier AI safety decisions and make the evidence behind those decisions understandable to the public. You will lead external research partnerships and third-party assessments, coordinate public safety documentation, and develop new approaches to independent scrutiny and transparency. Working across research, engineering, product, policy, and communications, you will help ensure external findings inform concrete decisions and that our public explanations accurately reflect the evidence, limitations, and remaining uncertainty.

We’re looking for people with deep experience in research partnerships and program management with technical and research teams. This role combines partnership management, cross-functional coordination, an understanding of AI safety research, alignment, and evaluations, and strong communication skills. You will work with researchers and engineers within OpenAI and across the external community to initiate projects, set ambitious goals and milestones, and drive execution across multiple teams.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

Work with researchers and external partners to define assessment questions, scope, access, timelines, and deliverables.

- Build and manage strategic research partnerships with third-party evaluators, academic labs, and other independent experts, prioritizing expertise, independence, and diversity of perspectives. Enable rigorous research, including work that challenges internal assumptions.

title: Associate Actuary, Pricing
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Actuary, Pricing is responsible for setting pricing assumptions to support Medicare Part D bids. You will provide guidance to Product Development on new product/benefit cost impacts. You will develop and maintain pricing tools that price standard and custom benefits. The Associate Actuary, Pricing develops and maintains projections of drug utilization trends for Humana 's Medicare Part D products to support pricing, forecasting, bid development, and strategic decision-making.

• Analyzes historical claims experience, emerging utilization patterns, member behavior, and market dynamics to identify key drivers of pharmacy cost trends and forecast future utilization at the drug, therapeutic class, and product levels.

• Leverages actuarial models, experience studies, and analytical tools to research root causes of utilization changes and capture actionable insights.

• Collaborates with pricing, forecasting, clinical, pharmacy, formulary, and finance teams to ensure utilization assumptions appropriately reflect emerging experience, operational initiatives, and industry developments.

• Monitors external factors, including new drug launches, loss of exclusivity events, clinical guideline changes, and regulatory impacts, to assess their influence on future utilization patterns.

• Communicates findings and recommendations to business partners and leadership, supporting sound forecasting and strategic planning decisions.

• Begins to influence department strategy through subject matter expertise in Medicare Part D utilization trends.

Use your skills to make an impact

• Associate of Society of Actuaries (ASA) designation

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills including the ability to translate complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Strong analytical skills

• SAS/SQL/R/Databricks programming experience

description:
The Performance Media Manager is responsible for leading the implementation, delivery, and optimisation of performance media campaigns across the News Corp network and other major publishers on behalf of clients.
This role ensures the seamless management of campaigns throughout their lifecycle, including forecasting, setup, QA, pacing, optimisation, and reporting. With a focus on accuracy and compliance, the Performance Media Manager mitigates risks to revenue by addressing under-pacing campaigns, resolving creative delays, and adhering to ad product rules and auditing standards.
Leveraging deep expertise in performance media, they influence booking practices to prioritise on-net inventory, optimise campaigns to achieve client outcomes at the lowest cost, and test new products to ensure margin requirements are met.
Accountabilities & Responsibilities
Campaign Management & Delivery

• Successfully manage and deliver performance media campaigns throughout their lifecycle, including pre-campaign forecasting, setup and QA, go-live pacing, optimisations, and end-of-campaign reporting.

• Maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail while working under pressure to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Identify and resolve under-pacing campaigns to mitigate revenue risks, ensuring timely and effective optimisations.

• Proactively address outstanding digital creative issues to ensure campaigns launch on time and meet client expectations.
Compliance & Best Practices

• Uphold ad product rules and ensure adherence to auditing compliance standards across all campaigns.

• Ensure accurate forecasts to prevent poor campaign practices, such as over-bidding, that negatively affect margin.

• Influence the acceptance of bookings by hedging high-risk inventory with alternate solutions, while prioritising and maximising on-net inventory.
Team Development & Collaboration

• Coach and develop partner team members, providing first-level support for their tasks and fostering a high-performance environment.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure campaign strategies align with client outcomes and organisational goals.
Product Testing & Validation

• Provide actionable insights and feedback to improve product performance and alignment with market needs.

Brown & Brown is seeking a Claim Associate to join our growing team!

This role is critical in maintaining organized workflows, supporting claim handlers, and facilitating communication with internal teams, external partners, and insureds.

title: Air Vehicle Engineer - Drone Stack
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Engineer within our Drone Stack team at Applied Intuition, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging hardware, edge software, and field flight operations. Split roughly 50/50 between the lab and the airfield, you will be responsible for bringing autonomous aerial systems from initial benchtop configuration to live operational flight.

In this role, you will configure embedded Linux environments, deploy and validate containerized software stacks, wire up mesh network topologies, and write key middleware glue code to keep subsystems communicating seamlessly. You are as comfortable with a soldering iron and oscilloscope at the bench as you are SSH-ing into an onboard computer over a mesh radio under field conditions.

This opportunity can also be located at our Drone Lab near Fort Walton Beach, Florida or at out Ann Arbor, MI office (relocation offered).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead System Bring-Up: Drive end-to-end hardware and software integration for unmanned aerial systems, moving platforms from benchtop prototyping to active flight test campaigns.

- Deploy & Configure Edge Software: Manage, configure, and deploy software stacks using Docker images, shell scripts, and Linux system tools across onboard computes and peripheral hardware.

- Field & Bench Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot vehicle networks, payload interfaces, and sensor links in real time using command-line tools (grep, less, journalctl, nano/vim) and hardware diagnostics (multimeters, oscilloscopes).

- Build Test Tooling & Glue Code: Develop Python and C++ scripts for data reduction, log analysis, system validation, and real-time subsystem verification.

- System Cabling & Electronics: Fabricate custom wiring harnesses, perform precision soldering, and define system-level architecture using clear block diagrams.

- Manage Communications & Networks: Configure IP routing, subnets, and local network interfaces between flight controllers, companion computers, radios, and ground control stations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in robotics integration, flight test engineering, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles (aerial background preferred).

- Linux & Networking Mastery: Deep practical comfort with the Linux CLI, file management, system logging, local IP routing, subnets, and containerized deployments (Docker).

- Hardware & Electronics Capability: Proven hands-on skills in wiring, custom cable assembly, bench soldering, and physical diagnostics using oscilloscopes and multimeters.

- Scripting & Glue Code: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or Shell scripting
